explanationEn: Topic: Cell Biology | Singer and Nicolson proposed the Fluid Mosaic Model in 1972.

subject: Biology
textEn: Water is a universal solvent primarily due to its:
textUr: پاڻي هڪ عالمي حل ڪندڙ (Universal solvent) ڇو شمار ٿئي ٿو؟
explanationEn: Topic: Biological Molecules | Water's dipole structure allows it to dissolve polar and ionic solutes.

subject: Biology
textEn: Sucrose is a disaccharide composed of:
textUr: سڪروز ڪهڙن ٻن مونوسيڪرائيڊس مان ٺهيل آهي؟
explanationEn: Topic: Biological Molecules | Sucrose consists of one glucose and one fructose unit.

subject: Biology
textEn: Cellulose is a structural polysaccharide composed of:
textUr: سيلولوز ڪهڙي شگر جي يونٽس جو ٺهيل هوندو آهي؟
explanationEn: Topic: Biological Molecules | Cellulose consists of unbranched chains of beta-1,4-glycosidic linked glucose.

subject: Biology
textEn: The primary structure of a protein is defined by its:
textUr: پروٽين جي پرائمري ساخت مان ڇا مراد آهي؟
explanationEn: Topic: Biological Molecules | Primary structure refers to the sequence of amino acids joined by peptide bonds.

subject: Biology
textEn: Light reactions of photosynthesis take place in the:
textUr: فوٽوسنٿسز جو روشني واريون تعاملات (Light reactions) ڪٿي ٿينديون آهن؟
explanationEn: Topic: Bioenergetics | Light reactions occur on the thylakoid membranes of chloroplasts.

subject: Biology
textEn: Oxygen released during photosynthesis originates from:
textUr: فوٽوسنٿسز دوران خارج ٿيندڙ آڪسيجن ڪنهن مان ايندي آهي؟
explanationEn: Topic: Bioenergetics | Photolysis of water molecules yields O2 gas.

subject: Biology
textEn: The net gain of ATP molecules from one glucose molecule in aerobic respiration is:
textUr: هوائي ساهه کڻڻ (Aerobic respiration) ۾ هڪ گلوڪوز مان ڪل ڪيترا ATP حاصل ٿيندا آهن؟
explanationEn: Topic: Bioenergetics | Complete oxidation of one glucose yields 36-38 ATP.

subject: Biology
textEn: DNA replication takes place during which phase of the cell cycle?
textUr: سيل سائيڪل جي ڪهڙي مرحلي ۾ ڊي اين اي نئون ٺهندو (Replication) آهي؟
explanationEn: Topic: Genetics & Biotechnology | DNA replicates during the Synthesis (S) phase of interphase.

subject: Biology
textEn: Crossing over occurs during which stage of meiosis?
textUr: ميائوسس جي ڪهڙي مرحلي ۾ ڪراسنگ اوور (Crossing over) ٿيندي آهي؟
explanationEn: Topic: Cell Cycle | Crossing over takes place during pachytene stage of Prophase I.

subject: Biology
textEn: Mendel's Law of Independent Assortment applies to genes located on:
textUr: مينڊل جو آزاديءَ سان منتقل ٿيڻ وارو قانون ڪنهن تي لاڳو ٿئي ٿو؟
optionsUr: هڪ ئي ڪروموسوم تي متصل جينز
explanationEn: Topic: Genetics & Biotechnology | Independent assortment applies to genes on different homologous pairs.

subject: Biology
textEn: Bile juice is synthesized in the liver and stored in the:
textUr: بائل (Bile) جگر ۾ ٺهي ڪٿي ذخيرو ٿيندو آهي؟
explanationEn: Topic: Nutrition & Digestion | Bile is synthesized by hepatocytes and stored in the gall bladder.

subject: Biology
textEn: The primary site of gaseous exchange in human lungs is the:
textUr: انسان جي ڦڦڙن ۾ گئسن جي تبديليءَ جو بنيادي هنڌ ڪهڙو آهي؟
explanationEn: Topic: Gaseous Exchange & Respiration | Alveoli are thin-walled sacs where oxygen diffuses into blood capillaries.

subject: Biology
textEn: Which blood cells are responsible for carrying oxygen?
textUr: رت جا ڪهڙا سيل آڪسيجن کڻڻ جي ذميواري ادا ڪندا آهن؟
explanationEn: Topic: Biological Molecules | Erythrocytes contain hemoglobin which binds and transports oxygen.

subject: Biology
textEn: The structural and functional unit of the human kidney is the:
textUr: انساني ڱڙدي (Kidney) جي ساختي ۽ افعالي اکائي (Unit) ڪهڙي آهي؟
explanationEn: Topic: Homeostasis & Excretion | Nephron is the microscopic functional unit of the kidney.

subject: Biology
textEn: Total number of bones in an adult human skeleton is:
textUr: بالغ انسان جي ڍانچي ۾ ڪل ڪيتريون هڏيون هونديون آهن؟
explanationEn: Topic: Support & Movement | Adult human skeleton consists of 206 bones.

subject: Biology
textEn: The junction between two neurons is called a:
textUr: ٻن نيورونس جي ملڻ واري هنڌ کي ڇا چئبو آهي؟
explanationEn: Topic: Nervous & Chemical Coordination | Synapse is the junction where nerve signals transmit via neurotransmitters.

subject: Biology
textEn: The concept of natural selection as the mechanism of evolution was proposed by:
textUr: ارتقاءَ لاءِ قدرتي چونڊ جو نظريو ڪنهن پيش ڪيو؟
explanationEn: Topic: Genetics & Biotechnology | Charles Darwin proposed evolution by natural selection in 1859.
